# Silly Bon

> The silliest relationship app for couples — mood memes, partner taps, and home screen widgets.

Silly Bon is a mobile couples app (Android on Google Play; iOS coming soon). It helps partners stay connected through playful mood memes, tiny interact taps, and Android home-screen widgets.

Website: https://sillybon.com/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sillybon.app
Support: support@sillybon.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sillybondog/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@sillybondog
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sillybondog

## Key facts

- Product type: couples / relationship lifestyle app
- Platforms: Android (available now), iOS (coming soon)
- Core features: mood memes, partner taps (Miss U, Pat, Love, etc.), home screen widgets, shared pair Premium, daily questions, silly dog mascots
- Tagline: "The silliest relationship app."
- Positioning: a tiny playground for couples who are a little weird, a little silly, and somehow still in love
- Official email: support@sillybon.com
